record.one_liner: Graph database platform queried with Cypher, offered self-managed and as the AuraDB cloud service, with HTTP Query and Aura management APIs.
record.auth_notes: Query API accepts HTTP Basic or Bearer tokens. Aura API uses a Client ID and Client Secret created in the console, then a Bearer token; the token exchange itself was not read. Bearer tokens for the Query API are generated by the application or identity provider (not read in detail).
record.access_notes: Aura API credentials can be created on every tier, including Free, per the Aura API authentication page. Aura Free and trial accounts without billing are limited to 25 requests per minute.
record.api_notes: The hinted URL neo4j.com/docs/api returned 404, so the Query API and Aura API docs were used instead. Primary data access is Bolt drivers, which were not fetched. The HTTP Query API runs Cypher, and the Aura API covers instance management.
